Analyst.scientific_hypothesis: Restricting the local pointwise support to the three-atom aromatic fragment (slots 6, 13, 22) in region F_b011_s030__NC changes the terminal affinity distribution relative to the 20-slot reference region under the same parent program. The mechanism under test is that a smaller, chemically coherent local support reduces assignment ambiguity and spurious long-range point matching, so the retained local geometry is more often compatible with the terminal teacher target. This is a geometric hypothesis about local support size and coherence; it does not assert a hydrogen-bond role, an interaction energy, or a causal internal model module.
